ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.3:0.7 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across visible ventral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white region concentrated on the left lobe's ventral surface with irregular low-intensity black vertical striations; central and right-central areas are dominated by low-intensity black pixels; sparse high-intensity white spotting on the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 70 degrees; depth relative to lobe height is approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; left lobe exhibit 12-15 distinct peaks of variable pixel amplitude (2-10px); right lobe serrations are partially obscured by water turbulence and shadowing.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe lateral margin follows a convex curve transitioning to a linear trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a similar convexity but is partially obscured by spray.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal lateral tip of the left lobe and the dorsal/lateral margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several high-contrast vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) bisecting the white pigmentation field on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep U-shaped indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 40% distance from the lateral tip to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ink-drop' mottling pattern where dark pigmentation bleeds into the white field on the lower left quadrant of the fluke.
